name: Guest Mode Preview
route: No live route; pre-auth guest preview handoff from the account entry flow.
annotation: HIFI-06 · no route · dark shell + top orange glow & purple CIA mesh

modules.build: Transparent top bar. Back chevron (left), no trailing glyphs. Balencia symbol mark (centered, 28px).
Display 34: 'take a *look* around' (1 Tiempos italic emphasis word). Body-light 16: 'tell us your name and pick a few areas you care about.'
GlassPillInput text variant. Placeholder: 'your name'. Focus = 1px orange border + subtle orange glow. 44px touch target.

ConstellationRadar in FrostCard r40 (glow-cia purple mesh). Empty state: quiet dot glyph, no nodes, copy 'pick a few areas to see your map.' Once 1+ node lights, persistent ChipProvenance 'demo · illustrative' (never omitted).

Overline caps: 'life areas' + counter '(0 selected)'. 3x3 grid ChipDomainTag: Fitness, Nutrition, Mental, Finance, Career, Relationships, Spirituality, Learning, Creativity. All unselected (domain 16% tint), 44px touch target wrapping ~36px visual pill.
BtnPrimary: 'Explore'. Disabled (40% opacity) is the default/cold-start state; requires 1+ name char and 1 selected chip to reach full opacity.
BtnGhost: 'Already have an account? Sign in', orange #FF5E00 label (6.4:1 contrast on --surface-1).

trustControls: Radar carries persistent ChipProvenance 'demo · illustrative' once 1+ node is lit - never omitted, so the preview can't be mistaken for a real Life Power reading.
Cap-reached error: 4th chip tap triggers 150ms shake on the tapped chip + toast 'pick up to 3 areas.' - the chip doesn't select; the other 3 stay selected.
Network/init failure: quiet ErrorState banner above the CTA - 'couldn't start your preview - check your connection' + BtnSecondary 'retry.'
Loading: BtnPrimary label swaps to spinner only (width locked) - no literal 'Loading' text, per the catalog's BtnPrimary loading spec.
notes: No ConsentCard: screen captures only a display name and non-health category preferences - CANON 8's consent trigger doesn't fire here; justified omission, not an oversight.
Accessibility: chip touch targets use invisible 44px padding (visual pill stays ~36px) to hit the iOS HIG / WCAG floor without disrupting the dense 3x3 grid.

Accessibility debt (documented, not silently passed): BtnPrimary's paper-50-on-orange label computes to 3.0:1 - clears the 3:1 large-text/UI floor but misses 4.5:1 for normal-weight text; this is an inherited canon-wide BtnPrimary token issue, not screen-specific.

Honesty triple: Real and Low-confidence are both not-applicable pre-account/pre-data; Honest-null ('pick a few areas to see your map.') is the only live state, with the ChipProvenance chip as the compensating illustrative-preview guard once nodes light up.

Spec drift flagged (not applied): the Visual System section names 'preview' as the italic emphasis word, but the actual composition italicizes 'look' in the only heading that appears on screen ('take a *look* around') - 'look' was used since 'preview' appears nowhere in the visible copy.
